name: Plate IX: The Chymical Wedding of Sun and Moon
description: Sol and Luna, the red king and the white queen, circling toward the conjunction from which the Mercury of the wise is born. Struck in Albedo: the whitening, the lunar washing of the matter. Degree of Adept, rank 153 of the folio. “AZOTH”: The universal medicine: A to Z, Alpha to Omega.
